facts.text: South Alabama's Early Acceptance Program offers qualifying high school seniors conditional admission to the Frederick P. Whiddon College of Medicine.

sources.title: Early Acceptance Programs (EAP) | Admissions
sources.quote: The CoM EAP offers a small number of qualified high school seniors a conditional acceptance to the University of South Alabama Frederick P. Whiddon College of Medicine contingent upon satisfactory completion of the Undergraduate program.
